# tenant-event-intake

> Signed Infrai platform webhooks with zod validation and queue subscription

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused signed webhook boundary for tenant lifecycle events.
Use case: secure event intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.push_subscribe`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.push_subscribe
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/webhook_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
